description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 01.09.2025 to 07.09.2025
reasoning: This gazette content establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and represents a statutory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs under delegated authority. The notification rescinds previous exchange rates and sets new legally binding rates, making it a regulatory matter falling under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel/structure categories.
